summary: The flat 2D vector aesthetic is clean with cohesive character design, clear typography, and well-executed facial expressions. However, shots 7 and 8 repeat the kitchen scene back-to-back without variety, shot 7 misses depicting an actual sink or dumping action, and shots 3 and 4 over-sampled into 3 frames each, omitting shot 11 from the sheet.

clean: Shot 0: Hand grip on the mate gourd rests naturally against the side with fingers curled over the edge.
Shot 1: Arms raise smoothly to touch the head in shock without unnatural limb distortion.
Shot 6 & 8: Drinking gestures correctly bring the bombilla to the mouth.
Shot 10: Mate hand-off connects hand-to-hand without the gourd floating in mid-air.
unclean: Shot 4: Background shows two duplicate brick ovens/parrillas and dining chairs duplicated side-by-side like a repeated wallpaper tile rather than a coherent room layout.
Shot 7: Script mentions spitting or dumping the mate into a sink ('pileta'), but the visual only shows the figure standing at the counter with a giant red 'X' graphic overlay.
Shot 10: Characters face forward toward the camera while passing the mate sideways rather than turning slightly toward each other.

clean: Shots 2 and 9: Board templates have crisp typography, balanced card hierarchy, and high contrast against dark backgrounds.
Consistent color palette across backgrounds, clothing, and props.
Good character expressions matching the emotional tone of the narration.
unclean: Shot 3: Redundant text duplicate where large teal headline 'MATE DEL ZONZO' sits directly above an identical pill badge 'MATE DEL ZONZO'.
Shots 7 and 8: Consecutive shots reuse the identical kitchen counter framing and red-shirt character without zoom, camera angle shift, or background variation.
Grid sampling: Shots 3 and 4 each took 3 grid cells instead of 2, pushing the final call-to-action shot 11 out of the 24-frame contact sheet.

issues.problem: Duplicate label text displaying 'MATE DEL ZONZO' twice simultaneously in cells 8 and 9.
issues.fix: Remove the pill badge when the large headline already displays the exact same name.

issues.problem: Narration describes spitting or dumping the mate into the sink ('pileta'), but visual is a static counter stance with an 'X'.
issues.fix: Show a pileta/sink asset with the gourd being tipped over or liquid pouring out.

issues.problem: Background repeats identical brick chimneys and chairs side by side like an unscaled tiled pattern.
issues.fix: Center a single fireplace/parrilla in the background composition instead of duplicating the asset horizontally.

issues.problem: Shots 7 and 8 repeat the exact same kitchen background back-to-back with minimal variation.
issues.fix: Cut to a close-up framing or change the character/setting for the stoic drinker.

issues.problem: Figures passing the mate stand flatly facing the viewer instead of turning towards each other.
issues.fix: Rotate figure bodies slightly inwards so the pass occurs chest-to-chest as specified in QA pass rules.

learnings.rule: Do not render callout pill badges pointing to a prop when the main headline already states the exact same phrase.
When the script specifically mentions an action and prop like dumping into a sink ('pileta'), render the sink and pouring motion rather than placing an abstract red X over a generic pose.
